summary: Fix BUG-0186: the matched dlm-controld image used BuildKit-only COPY --chmod, so an ISO build on a Docker install without buildx failed after the appliance and Core package were already rebuilt. Plain COPY plus RUN chmod builds on both builders, and a check rejects BuildKit-only syntax in any Dockerfile. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Build-tooling portability inside the release build; no operator workflow, GUI, CLI or installer behaviour changes, and the produced image is unchanged.

api.reason: No Controller/Core or client-facing contract is involved: this changes how one build container copies a script, not any endpoint, command, event or schema.

roadmap.reason: A build fix; no published milestone scope or completion status changes.

state.reason: Build tooling only; it creates and stores no durable product state.

verification.method: Reproduced by building the 0.2.3 ISO locally: the first run failed with 'the --chmod option requires BuildKit' after the appliance and Core package rebuild; with the fix, bash installer/build.sh completed and produced dist/nex-core-0.2.3-amd64.iso. The new check failed on the old Dockerfile and passes with the fix. Disposable QEMU boot-menu smoke and installer/check.sh passed; no installation, hardware, Secure Boot or hosted CI run is claimed.
